note: Benchmark-derived candidate orderings (population evidence). Cheapest-plausible first. A prior orders the probe, it never skips it. Sources, scores and caveats: references/benchmarks.md. Model names are the EXACT dispatch ids used by scripts/llm and recorded in kb.jsonl. Local-model caveat: published scores are for official full-precision releases; local quantized/community builds (MLX, -ud, finetunes) can score materially lower.

classification.basis: No dedicated public leaderboard; IFEval/LiveBench-IF are weak proxies. Local KB evidence dominates here (gpt-oss & qwen-coder both 10/10 locally).

extraction.basis: No strong public benchmark (ExtractBench emerging); schema discipline proxies via IFEval. Local KB evidence dominates (qwen-coder 8.8 local).

summarization.basis: Public summarization benchmarks unreliable (reference summaries judged worse than zero-shot LLM output, TACL 2024). Ordering from local KB (qwen-coder 8.5, gpt-oss 8.0, haiku 9.5 paid).

translation.basis: WMT has no entries for these locals; multilingual proxy MMMLU: gemma 86.3, sonnet 89.3, haiku 83.0. Local KB: qwen-coder 10.0x2, gpt-oss 9.9x3 on DE->EN (routing table recommends qwen-coder).

proofreading.basis: GEC research: strong chat models over-rewrite — restraint task. Local KB: all small locals FAIL (gpt-oss-20b 3.0). Calibrated 2026-06-10: or:gpt-oss-120b 10.0 and or:deepseek-v4-flash 10.0 at <1/10th haiku price; haiku 9.0 / sonnet 10.0 remain the no-external-data options.

qa-factual.basis: MMLU-Pro: qwen3.6-35B 85.2 > gemma4-26b 82.6 > nemotron 78.3; gpt-oss only plain MMLU 85.3. Haiku ~77 (low conf), sonnet via MMMLU 89.3.

codegen-simple.basis: LiveCodeBench v6: qwen3.6-35B 80.4, gemma4-26b 77.1, nemotron 68.3, glm-flash 64.0. qwen3-coder is coder-tuned (KB extraction-passing; codegen unproven locally — probe).

codegen-complex.basis: SWE-bench Verified: fable 95.0, opus4.8 88.6, sonnet4.6 79.6, haiku 73.3, qwen3.6-35B 73.4, gpt-oss-20b 60.7(high), glm-flash 59.2. Discount 2-5pts for memorization (SWE-bench Illusion). For repo-level agentic work prefer sonnet+; SWE-bench Pro discriminates at the top (fable 80.3 vs opus4.8 69.2).

code-review.basis: No mature public benchmark (2026 survey: fragmented). Weak proxy SWE-bench. Local KB n=1: gpt-oss & haiku 9.0 on short contained snippets; keep opus/fable for large-module subtle-correctness reviews.

reasoning.basis: MMLU-Pro + AIME: qwen3.6-35B 85.2/92.7, gpt-oss 91.7 AIME (high effort), gemma 82.6/88.3, haiku 80.7 AIME-no-tools, sonnet GPQA 89.9, opus4.8 GPQA 93.6. GPQA saturated at top — use MMLU-Pro/LiveBench to discriminate.

analysis.basis: LMArena overall: opus4.8 ~1479-1482, sonnet4.6 1470, gemma4-26b 1438, haiku 1411 (style-bias caveat). Local KB n=1: haiku 9.0 > sonnet 8.0 > opus 6.0 on grounded analysis — probe before trusting either signal.

creative-short.basis: LMArena Creative Writing: opus4.8 1454-1475, sonnet 1449, gemma4-26b 1403, haiku 1387, glm-flash 1312. Gemma is the strongest local for prose per Arena.

creative-long.basis: EQ-Bench longform + LMArena Creative favor frontier tiers for coherence over length; no local-model evidence. Probe before committing locals.
